name: Print & Sign Supply (B2B / Wholesale)
tagline: A wholesale storefront built for the print trade.
description: A complete, working wholesale shop for a print, signage & sublimation trade supplier: a real catalogue sold by the roll, box and case — cast vinyl & HTV, banner & board, eco-solvent & dye-sub ink, and sublimation blanks — with pack quantities, MOQs, categories, collections, a bespoke trade PDP (per-unit pricing, bulk breaks, net-30), and a full merchandised home page. Clean CMYK-adjacent theme — cool paper, press-ink primary, a magenta signal accent. Shipped as Inkyard Trade Supply.
